description: Get equity vesting schedules for one or more companies, decoded into structured data: per-year vesting percent and frequency (cliff/quarterly/monthly), whether there's a 1-year cliff, whether it's backloaded (e.g. Amazon 5/15/40/40) / frontloaded / linear, plus a plain-English description and vesting type (RSU, options). Pass company slugs (use search-companies to resolve names first). REQUIRED arguments: companySlugs. Array-typed arguments (companySlugs) must be passed as arrays, even for a single value.

companySlugs.description: Company slugs to fetch vesting schedules for.

name: get-vesting-schedules
